title: Escolha o mundo visual do site VINCERE
question: O sorteio atribuiu a Prancha de Projeto. Mantenha, escolha uma alternativa, ou sorteie de novo.

options.label: Prancha de Projeto
options.lineage: plan sheets, elevations and general notes from the fit-out of a shop, clinic or garage
options.thesis: The site is the plan sheet of the business's new front door: every interface shown as a measured elevation, every claim a dimension you can read.
options.viewport: Nav as the sheet's header strip with the mono wordmark and one coral pill, Start a project. Left: headline in Archivo wide with a single word in print blue, then the lede. Right: the Sasso concept as a flat browser elevation with a phone elevation overlapping, dimension lines annotating 1440 and 390, leaders naming the reservation button and the menu. A faint 8 px grid rules the whole sheet; the concept cards below are FIG. 1 to 4; the how-we-work facts become the title block; the contact section inverts to cyanotype blue.
options.risk: Reads as an architect's own site if the leaders annotate decoration instead of real interface facts; every dimension and callout must be true, so the drawing discipline is a content discipline.

raised.raise: Everything sits on a visible division grid, and every label reads a real measured value (widths, breakpoints, counts of sections), never a decorative number.
One obviously-the-point action: coral is worn only by Start a project, once per screen, with real press travel; nothing else on the sheet is warm.
No shadowed cards. Hierarchy comes from rule weight and scale; a detail frame is drawn only around the four figures, because a plan sheet frames details and nothing else.
One ruling vertical axis: the dimension-leader column aligns the hero elevation, the figures and the form, so the page reads as one sheet, not stacked sections.
Each section keeps an unmarked field; the sheet breathes because empty vellum is a region, not leftover.

options.label: Fachada e Letreiro
options.lineage: painted storefront signage, gold-leaf window lettering, striped awnings
options.thesis: Your website is your new storefront: the page is a shop front dressed by a sign painter, and the concept sites are what is on display in the window.
options.viewport: A wide awning band across the top carries the wordmark as outlined window lettering; below it the window shows the Sasso concept as the display; the CTA is the OPEN sign, flipped to face the street; services are painted panels on the fascia.
options.risk: Familiar warmth: sign-painter aesthetics are widely used by cafés and craft brands, and it is the most small-business of the set, which can undercut the software future the brand needs to keep open.

options.label: Silver-age comic page
options.lineage: ben-day dots and four-color misregistration on pulp
options.thesis: The company story as a six-panel page with action lettering.
options.viewport: Six panels, caption boxes handing off between scenes.
options.risk: Playful register undercuts a professional buyer.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a dentist or shop owner does not identify their business with a comic, and the register fights the word professional.
options.kept: One reserved color for the action state, worn by nothing else.

options.label: Creator hardware bench
options.lineage: gunmetal chassis, putty keycaps, one safety-orange key
options.thesis: Every offer is a physical key; one orange key is obviously the point.
options.viewport: A keycap grid of services with one orange Start key.
options.risk: Reads as a product for makers, not for shop owners.
options.case: Holds neither axis: the audience does not read gear culture, though the single-action discipline is exactly what a lead-gen page needs.
options.kept: One obviously-the-point action with real press travel.

options.label: Accretion disk threshold
options.lineage: warped horizons, photon ring, void black
options.thesis: Growth as matter crossing an irreversible threshold.
options.viewport: A black field with the offer bent along ring bands.
options.risk: Cosmic spectacle says nothing a business owner can act on.
options.case: Loses both: no identification and the offer disappears into the effect.
options.kept: The center held unmarked: empty space treated as a region.

options.label: Mesophotic deep dive
options.lineage: dive-computer digits, thermocline cyan, marine snow
options.thesis: The project as a descent through stages, depth ruling every line.
options.viewport: A vertical dive profile with the process as depth stops.
options.risk: Dark, technical and slow for a visitor who wants to know the price of a website.
options.case: Loses both: the metaphor is foreign to the audience and buries the action.
options.kept: One vertical axis rules every line of copy.

options.label: CRT oscilloscope bench
options.lineage: phosphor trace over an etched ten-division graticule
options.thesis: Every claim measured against a visible grid.
options.viewport: A green trace of the process locked still on a graticule.
options.case: Loses both, but its measurement discipline is the strongest donation in the hand.
options.kept: Everything measured against a visible division grid; labels read real values.

options.label: Cracktro scroller queue
options.lineage: one bitmap face over a black void, depth as rank, nothing enclosed
options.thesis: Hierarchy by depth and brightness, never by boxes.
options.viewport: Ivory lines of text riding baselines over drifting dust fields.
options.risk: Demoscene nostalgia is invisible to the audience.
options.case: Loses both on identification and clarity, but its refusal of enclosure is a discipline the assigned sheet needed.
options.kept: No cards: hierarchy by scale and rule weight, enclosure only where the drawing frames a detail.

canonCard.label: A página de agência clara
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, and what the Smultron reference is: white ground, friendly geometric sans, one gradient keyword, pill CTA, tilted device mockups, service cards.
canonCard.viewport: Headline with a gradient keyword and a pill CTA on the left; a gradient block with a curved edge on the right holding phones at an angle; then a strip, service cards, and case-study cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the reference and its peers by design, and the form leans on trust devices (client logos, ratings, counts) that VINCERE cannot truthfully show.
